stop: Stop after the two pilot shards: they measure generator s/episode, bytes/episode and the label cost share on a 3090 for the Stage B data proposal (docs/board/generator.md).
_doc: Generator pilot on one rented 3090: one 300-episode plated train shard plus one 50-episode plated cal shard through the runner adapter (cfcap/compute_tasks.py GEN_SHARD -> cfcap.gen.shard.write_shard). unit_s is a deliberately generous bound (local 4070 smoke: ~20 episodes in ~4 s labels + ~18 s first-shape CUDA-graph capture; compile warm-up ~3-5 s per shape); the sidecar shard_*.json (gen_seconds, bytes, stats.label/probe) gives the measured numbers. engine compile falls back to graph automatically if inductor/triton is unusable on the box.

groups.name: gen-pilot-train
groups.pilot: local 4070 Ti S smoke of cfcap.gen (fe24b9d): 20 train episodes probed+labelled with engine graph, labels 4.0 s, probes 18 s (first-shape capture); bound set generously at 20 min
groups.purpose: Measure generator throughput (s/episode), bytes/episode and label cost share on a 3090 to size the Stage B train/cal/test/held-out data.

groups.name: gen-pilot-cal
groups.pilot: as gen-pilot-train (local 4070 smoke, fe24b9d); bound 10 min
groups.purpose: Check the cal split path and the cold-start (compile) overhead per job on a fresh process.
